concerns.text: T015 defines 'Primary Baseline' as 'ALL other vaccines' but also creates a 'Non-COVID, Non-Flu' subset. The task description is ambiguous about which group is used for the main analysis vs. sensitivity checks, creating a conflict with the spec (FR-007) and plan. The implementer cannot deterministically decide which baseline to use for the primary ROR/PRR/IC calculation without external clarification.

T027 requires implementing sensitivity analysis comparing 'Non-COVID (all other vaccines)' vs 'Flu-only'. This contradicts the spec (FR-007) and plan which mandate comparing 'Non-COVID, Non-Flu' vs 'Flu-only'. The task description provides the wrong logic, making it impossible to execute the task correctly as written.

T008 ('Implement src/data/validate.py') is marked as incomplete/rejected in the context of the review, yet T012 and T014 depend on it. The task description assumes the existence of `dataset.schema.yaml` (T006) which is also marked incomplete. The task is not self-contained; it cannot be executed without the schema file being present and defined.

T039 and T040 set memory thresholds at 5 GB and 7 GB respectively. The spec (FR-006) and plan define a single global constraint of '< 7 GB'. The 5 GB threshold in T039 is an arbitrary internal value not authorized by the spec. An implementer cannot justify this specific number without violating the 'Single Source of Truth' principle or guessing.

T055 requires the report to include a 'Background Rate Unknown' disclaimer. However, the project notes explicitly state that T024b (which handled this flagging) was removed because it was inconsistent with the ROR/PRR/IC methodology. The task demands an artifact that the project design explicitly rejected, creating a logical contradiction for the implementer.

T015 is too coarse. It combines data filtering, MedDRA mapping, memory optimization, and output generation into a single task. While the atomizer will split this, the current description mixes multiple distinct deliverables (cleaned CSV, parquet, memory logs) making it hard to verify completion of just the filtering logic.

T026 is marked as 'rejected/missing output/signals.csv' in the review context, yet it is a prerequisite for T027, T028, T032, T053, T054, T055. The task cannot be executed because its prerequisite artifact is explicitly flagged as missing/failed in the current state.
